response.summary: The Vertex card path is wired through provider construction, connection checks, and reel fallbacks, but legacy/default Gemini paths remain on the retired model and changing a Vertex connection back to AI Studio preserves Vertex transport behavior.

findings.evidence: These shared defaults still specify gemini-2.5-flash. A deployment configured through GEMINI_API_KEYS (including the legacy video fallback/migration path in app/ai_connections.py:627) but without an explicit GEMINI_MODEL will continue to call the model that the plan says returns 404 for new users; Docker additionally injects that old value by default.
findings.fix: Change all runtime, Docker, sample-environment, and documented GEMINI_MODEL defaults to gemini-3.5-flash, and add coverage for the legacy GEMINI_API_KEYS video path.

findings.evidence: _validate starts with the target card's caps and then unconditionally overlays existing.caps. Updating an existing Vertex connection to card='gemini' therefore retains {'vertex': true}; build_provider and check_connection will still use vertexai=True / check_vertex even though the stored card and UI say AI Studio. The inverse switch can likewise retain stale card-specific caps.
findings.fix: When card changes, start from the target card caps and merge only explicitly user-editable, transport-independent existing caps (or remove card-owned flags such as vertex before merging). Add round-trip tests for vertex→gemini and gemini→vertex updates.

findings.evidence: The Vertex card directs users to docs/gemini_pro_credit_setup.md, but that file is absent from the repository's docs directory. A user following the advertised setup instructions cannot complete the documented setup flow.
findings.fix: Add the referenced setup guide, or replace the reference with an existing, maintained guide/link and test or review the rendered card copy.

coverage: Read the supplied plan and all seven changed-manifest files/diff sections.
Traced connection validation, persistence/update behavior, legacy migration and environment defaults in app/ai_connections.py and app/config.py.
Traced provider construction, video-slot chains, Gemini fallback behavior, and reel vision/audio callers.
Inspected shipped environment/Docker/README model defaults and the referenced documentation path.
limitations: Read-only review: no tests or runtime requests were run.
